The dithercn agent skill, for building any dither on the engine, is at /.well-known/agent-skills/dithercn/SKILL.md. dithercn Docs Examples Engine Search GitHub 140 stars Toggle theme Get started Introduction Installation Theming Examples Catalog Backgrounds 31 Dither gradient Dither glow Mesh gradient Aurora Noise field Waves Plasma Beams Silk Smoke Fire Flow field Contours Ripples Rain Ridgelines Metaballs Voronoi Cells Tunnel Retro grid Eclipse Black Hole Horizon Starfield Galaxy Halftone Moiré Dither globe Dot map Dither orb Dither fade Charts 11 Interface 12 Text 4 Images 5 Engine Dither engine Write your own dither Palettes Pixel scale Motion Performance Export Aurora Copy Copy Page Previous Next Curtains of light that fold, sway and shimmer, drawn as a dither, with knobs for colour, rays, tilt and drift. Your headline

); } Each curtain has a bright lower edge that folds slowly, with rays that fade as they rise. Further curtains hang higher and dimmer. height sets where the lowest edge hangs, so you can keep the area under it clear for text. The props group into three jobs: Shape: curtains, height, spread, sway, turbulence, rays, length. Light and colour: color for the edges, tipColor for the tops of the rays, background, glow, intensity, shimmer. Pass palette to set every tone yourself. Placement and motion: tilt, scale, drift, direction, mask, plus the engine's speed, cell and matrix. Examples Above a headline Raising height lifts the curtains off the lower third, where the headline sits on clean paper. A tipColor of "blue" shifts the tops of the rays to a second, cooler hue, and mask="edges" fades the sides. Preview Code Replay Expand Northern lights Your own colours turn it into the real thing: green edges, violet tips and a background that is a pale sky in light mode and a night sky in dark, set as CSS variables on the wrapper so the shader follows the theme. Four curtains, longer rays, a slight tilt and a little drift give it depth. Preview Code Replay Expand Hanging over a call to action direction="down" flips the curtains so the rays fall from the top and the button sits on clear paper below. Few broad rays and 4px cells give it a coarser, poster-like grain. Preview Code Replay Expand Still, in a banner With animate={false} it draws one frame. stillTime picks which moment, so you can choose a shape you like. Preview Code Replay Expand Props Prop Type Default color The bright lower edge of each curtain. DitherColor "--dither-ink" tipColor The faint tops of the rays. Set a second colour for a two-tone sky. DitherColor color background The sky behind. DitherColor "--dither-paper" curtains How many curtains, from 1 to 6.
